title: Bank Accounts — empty list
description: The bank accounts tab for a freshly created budget, before any account exists.

title: Create account — form filled
description: The new-account modal with alias and currency filled; positive-balance toggle defaults on.

title: Create account — success
description: Success toast and the new account listed.

title: Create account — duplicate alias error
description: Reusing an existing alias in the same budget is rejected with ALIAS_DUPLICATE.

title: Edit account — form
description: Edit modal with the alias changed (currency is locked once created).

title: Edit account — success
description: Success toast and the updated alias reflected in the list.

title: Delete account — confirm dialog
description: The destructive-action confirmation, naming the account by alias.

title: Delete account — success
description: Success toast; the deleted account drops out of the default (active-only) list.

title: Show deleted — toggle on
description: Toggling "Show deleted" reveals the soft-deleted account (dimmed, "deleted" badge) with a Restore action.

title: Restore account — success
description: The account is active again after restore.
